snippet.title: The Arab League of Misfits | Official Gamescom Trailer
snippet.description:
The Arab League of Misfits is a 1v1 tactical deckbuilder fueled by Arab pop culture and historical satire. Command 140 unique cards to outsmart your opponent in a high-stakes argument using flying slippers and perfectly timed insults.

- Master seven distinct playstyles in the single-player roguelite campaign or crush real opponents in the PvP arena. 
- We rejected predatory monetization entirely: You buy the game once and receive the complete card set immediately with no randomized packs nor microtransactions.

Wishlist The Arab League of Misfits on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5042760/The_Arab_League_of_Misfits/

Follow the development and join the community:
